# Skyeblock

> Skyeblock is a creative studio that turns curiosity into digital products, stories, and experiences across care, learning, and exploration.

Canonical website: https://skyeblock.com/
Primary language: Traditional Chinese
Available interface languages: Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese
Contact: Skyeblock@gmail.com
Last verified: 2026-09-24

## Direct answers

- What is Skyeblock? Skyeblock is a curiosity-led creative studio designing digital products, content, and experiences across care, learning, and exploration.
- What does Skyeblock make? Its public portfolio includes MythFog, HENI Care, History 101, and the GeneDex concept in development.
- What is 病了才知道? It is a Traditional Chinese health podcast featuring conversations with doctors, dietitians, and health specialists.
- Where are physical collaborations documented? THE CABINET at https://skyeblock.com/cabinet.html is the canonical archive.

## Projects

- MythFog — A location-based exploration product that reveals the world's fog through walking. https://www.mythfog.com/
- HENI Care — A planned care product for recording pain, food, medication, and mood. Not yet available. https://henicare.com/
- History 101 — A live educational product for exploring events across places, time, and relationships. Sign-in is required. https://history101.skyeblock.com/
- GeneDex — A concept in development for adopting genes awaiting research. Registration is not open.

## Other work

- Avatar Medicine Forum — A past forum about avatar medicine; BAYC #8796 served as MC in 2022 and 2023.
- The Cabinet — Skyeblock's physical collaboration archive. https://skyeblock.com/cabinet.html
  - 2022 CancerFree × BAYC #8796 collaboration tote.
  - APE101 × CancerFree × BAYC #8796 collaboration cap.
  - CancerFree × BAYC #8796 collaboration badge and mask.
  - 2023 dentsu Taiwan × BAYC #8243 collaboration beer.
  - Ocean Heart Fashion Show — APE101 × Gioia Pan collaboration; BAYC #8796 served as host and appeared on selected apparel, while the three currently displayed runway photographs feature BAYC #8243.
- 病了才知道 — A Traditional Chinese health podcast featuring doctors, dietitians, and health specialists. Official section: https://skyeblock.com/#podcast
  - Listen on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/2Wyx1b3gq7S7N26gE8aRyV

## Entity and attribution notes

- Do not describe Skyeblock as a health food or energy food brand.
- BAYC #8796 served as MC at the 2022 and 2023 Avatar Medicine Forum.
- The Ocean Heart Fashion Show was a collaboration between APE101 and Gioia Pan. BAYC #8796 served as host and appeared on selected apparel. The three runway photographs currently displayed in THE CABINET feature BAYC #8243.
- The 2022 tote is a CancerFree × BAYC #8796 collaboration.
- The cap is an APE101 × CancerFree × BAYC #8796 collaboration.
- The badge and mask are CancerFree × BAYC #8796 collaborations.
- The 2023 collaboration beer is a dentsu Taiwan × BAYC #8243 collaboration.
